Unit Settings

Unit configuration
Squadron Details
to
This is the default used only when you generate new Parade Nights — it never changes nights that already exist. To move already-generated Parade Nights to a new day, change this setting and save: a preview of the affected nights appears before anything moves.
Link to an image hosted elsewhere — must start with http:// or https://. Leave blank to use the default crest.
Session Structure

How many training periods a new parade night starts with. A timing template decides this for any night that uses one — the count comes from its Training Period blocks. This value is used only when no template applies to that date, or the template has no Training Period blocks. Typing a different number while creating a night overrides both. Changing this does not alter parade nights that already exist.

Display Size

Adjust spacing to fit more content on screen. Both settings meet accessibility requirements at 200% zoom. Your preference is saved for this browser session.

Comfortable is the default and recommended setting for most users.

Training Years

Each training year holds its own parade dates, training classes and holiday periods. Roll a year over to start the next one from a copy rather than rebuilding it by hand.

Loading…

Timing Templates
Named parade night schedules with ordered blocks. Training Period blocks generate schedulable curriculum sessions. New parade nights automatically use the template effective on their date.
Loading…
Training Classes

A Training Class is a local group completing a Training Stage — for example, Senior 1 and Senior 2 can both complete Senior training on the same Parade Night. Associate Training Classes with a year.

Custom Training Phases

Named stretches of the calendar that sit outside the normal terms — a pre-course period or a camp block — so parade nights inside them are labelled correctly.

🔑 Access Code
Change your own sign-in code. Existing codes cannot be viewed. The previous code cannot be recovered once changed.
To reset another user's code, use the User Directory section below (admin only). All resets are recorded in the audit log.

Select a user to reset their access code. You can only reset users within your authorised unit. The old code cannot be recovered.

Curriculum Import
Upload the AAFC training schedule workbook (.xlsm) to import all curriculum items from zz - Program backend. Safe to run multiple times without creating duplicates.
Initial Account Setup
Creates the first available squadron under the first active Wing (if missing) and one account each for national_admin, wing_admin, and sqn_admin. Codes are generated server-side, shown once, and never retrievable again. Safe to re-run — only missing accounts are created. Use optional body {"wing_code":"…","sqn_code":"…"} to target a specific Wing.

Add custom training phase

A custom phase names a stretch of the calendar that sits outside the normal terms — a pre-course period or a camp block, for example — so parade nights inside it are labelled correctly.

Leave the end date blank for an open-ended phase.

Edit custom training phase

Leave the end date blank for an open-ended phase.

Split Training Class

The unselected cadets stay in the original class. Past sessions and attendance history for every cadet are kept exactly as recorded.

Merge Training Class

All cadets in this class move to the class you select. This class archives — its history and past sessions are preserved and can be restored later.

Curriculum Progress

CodeTitleStatus
Copy sessions to another parade night

Copies the planning details of each session (curriculum item, facilitator, room, Training Class audience) from this parade night to the selected night. Sessions already at the same period in the target are not changed.

Apply a session template

Applies the session structure of the selected template to this parade night. Training Class audiences are not copied — assign them after applying. Periods already occupied are not changed.

No templates saved yet. Open a parade night with sessions and choose "Save as Template".
